narrative: The gitweave repo shed its April-2026 spike artefacts — a dead metrics service, stub modules, broken tests, and stale CI jobs — leaving only live tooling. Developers now clone a repo whose full test suite passes green, whose bootstrap script runs without Docker, and whose legal files (AGPL-3 LICENSE, Apache ICLA CLA.md) are in place. The baseline is honest: every file present is there because something needs it.
